```{=html}
  </div>
</section>

<section class="c-slab c-slab--white">
  <div class="c-wrap">
    <div class="c-slab-head">
      <span class="c-eyebrow">How a project starts</span>
      <h2 class="c-h2">From question to workstream</h2>
      <p class="c-lede">
        Projects are not assigned. They begin when someone in the centre can
        state a question, name the data that would answer it, and commit to
        seeing it through to a submitted manuscript.
      </p>
    </div>

    <div class="c-grid-4">
      <div class="c-card">
        <span class="c-card-meta">Step 01</span>
        <h3>Question</h3>
        <p>A specific, answerable question, with the reason it matters for health in Bangladesh written down before any analysis starts.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="c-card">
        <span class="c-card-meta">Step 02</span>
        <h3>Data and method</h3>
        <p>The datasets are identified and the analysis plan is agreed with a supervisor, so the method is fixed before the results are seen.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="c-card">
        <span class="c-card-meta">Step 03</span>
        <h3>Analysis</h3>
        <p>Students run the analysis themselves, in code that is reviewed and kept, under one-to-one supervision rather than delegation.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="c-card">
        <span class="c-card-meta">Step 04</span>
        <h3>Output</h3>
        <p>Manuscript, code release and, where useful, a reusable pipeline. The student who did the work takes first authorship.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="c-slab c-slab--panel">
  <div class="c-wrap">
    <div class="c-slab-head">
      <span class="c-eyebrow">Get involved</span>
      <h2 class="c-h2">Join a project, or bring one</h2>
      <p class="c-lede">
        Students join existing workstreams and take a defined piece of the
        analysis. Collaborators with a dataset and a question can start a new
        one — we work in the open and publish jointly.
      </p>
    </div>

    <div class="c-btn-row">
      <a class="c-btn c-btn--solid" href="/opportunities/">Join as a student</a>
      <a class="c-btn c-btn--ghost" href="/collaborators/">Collaborate with us</a>
      <a class="c-btn c-btn--ghost" href="/publications/">All publications</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```
